escalated.item: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT of Microsoft.Android.Sdk.Windows 36.1.69, Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.Mono.android-arm64 10.0.12 and the AOT Cross 10.0.12 packs contain BSD-2-Clause text. Their licence families need a compound SPDX expression that the Contracts-ported provenance table does not admit, so they are not yet carried. The provenance checker was not changed in unit 4.
escalated.resolution: Resolved in AND.40 unit 5b (decisions 19 and 20). The SDK, Mono runtime and AOT Cross bundle expressions are admitted in eng/check_provenance.py LICENCES and eng/policy/reuse-policy.json (successor contracts-provenance-port-r2) and recorded by maui-android-sdk-bundle-r1, maui-mono-runtime-bundle-r1 and maui-mono-aot-cross-bundle-r1. The Mono runtime bundle text is retained and carried by the distribution notice set; the SDK bundle is build tooling; its gnu/binutils section is host-only.

hostOnly.sourceBundle: Microsoft.Android.Sdk.Windows 36.1.69 THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT, section gnu/binutils (BEGIN to END marker)
hostOnly.rationale: The GPL-3.0 binutils tools (the assembler and linker used by the host during AOT) are not packaged. The Debug and Release APKs of the unit-5 gate build contain no binutils member by name and no binutils content signature (GNU ld, GNU assembler, GNU objcopy, libbfd, GNU gold, binutils-gdb).
